, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family. Tom liked to play outside with his dog, Spot. One day, they went for a walk in the forest.
As they walked, Tom's dad said, "Be careful, Tom. Don't go too far." But Tom saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. His dad warned him, "Be careful, Tom. You might fall." Tom nodded and started to climb the tree.
As Tom climbed higher, he saw a big bird. The bird started to talk! The bird said, "Hello, Tom!" Tom was very surprised. He did not know that birds could talk. The bird told Tom that he was a magical bird. He could make one wish come true. Tom wished for a big ice cream cone. The bird made it happen, and Tom climbed down. They had a great day and went home with big smiles on their faces.
